name: mirage
text:
I turned on four engine sockets: PropLine, ParlayAPI, SX Bet and Novig. Your new tablet had written default settings with every socket off, and the engine had adopted them.

Why these four:
- PropLine (Streaming Lite) and ParlayAPI feed most of the fair odds, and their pushes keep the quotes from going stale. ParlayAPI's check currently reads 'free plan, 54 credits left', which looks like a stale or free-tier read. I turned its socket on because the engine's own advice line shows most of its paid credits left. Please check the key you re-entered is the Business one.
- SX Bet is free and sharp, and has 14 games in play right now.
- Novig's socket lets the engine read prices by push instead of by request. The phone isn't competing for that key now.

Left off:
- BoltOdds (API off, though its key is present) and SharpAPI (off by your 10-25 word, PropLine and ParlayAPI cover Pinnacle).
- Pinnodds: it is on the free plan with no socket.
- Kalshi's socket: the engine has no Kalshi key since you lost yours. Send a new one from Settings > Kalshi and I'll turn it on.

Revert is one line per socket if any misbehaves. I'll check the engine's socket line on the next run.
